Views: GPT turnaround of the concept (turnaround/README.md). No regions.json: families.table = flat colours sampled (median clusters) off the concept (+ the turnaround's body whites); families.body names the body family.

families._spanOpen: 2026-09-28 (scripts/v6/README.md 'Span opening'): the x / z body spans are counted on the body mask opened with a 2 x 2 square, so the 1-px anti-alias halo columns / rows of dark outlines (mirror heads, lamps: greys classified as body) no longer widen W / L; setup auditors 2026-09-28
families._enclosedFg: white body, no see-through openings (research/v7/EYES-EXPERIMENT.md B): background = the near-white region connected to the image border; enclosed near-white (highlights inside the white body) is foreground
families._fgMax: the body is near-white (concept 236-241 darkest channel, turnaround 237-246): the default bg cut (235) would erase it; 252 keeps it solid (bg is 253-255 in the concept and every view)
families._fringe: fringe = the 247-252 anti-alias band along outlines (mirror edges); without it those px join the body family and widen its W span in front / rear (same fix as delivery_truck). 2026-09-27 setup audit: #f9f9f9 -> #fbfbfb because the regenerated top view's roof is 245-246 (it split between body and fringe); with it the side and top L spans both end on the bumper outlines (side / top origins 512.0 / 512.5 px, no shift needed; every view's centring offset <= 0.022 m)
families._viewTable: 2026-09-27: per-view colours of the families (scripts/v7/turnaround.mjs families --apply; out/turnaround/ambulance/families.proposal.json): each view's foreground colour clusters (>= 1 %) matched to the table's families with ONE per-view colour offset (side -2.9 -3.3 -4.9 · front -2.7 -3.3 -2.5 · rear -2.7 -3 -3.7 · top -3.1 -3.1 -4.3); ambiguous: none.
